Antwerp's trade: Belgium's last court jeweller, Henri Leysen, died at 75, nine months after his 171-year-old house went bankrupt.

Bankrupt 10 December 2025 under 81% Chinese ownership (Tesiro, since 2017), after 2023 revenue fell 50.5%; a new venture, Leysen Heritage, now carries the name.

Antwerpen: Henri Leysen, hofleverancier van België, overleed 6 september — zijn 171 jaar oude huis ging al in december failliet.

Antwerp's trade watches Beijing today: Botswana, Namibia, South Africa and China signed a natural-diamond framework.

De Beers CEO Al Cook attended, backed by the Natural and World Diamond Councils, linking African producers to Chinese consumers; Antwerp's cutting trade is not named.

Antwerpen: de Beijing-verklaring verbindt Afrikaanse producenten met Chinese kopers van natuurlijke diamant, maar zegt niets over waar de ruwe steen wordt geslepen.
